domains.ppia06: reproject and retain only compatible portable appearance choices
produce semantic/versioned presentation outputs without changing Character truth

blocking_invariants: Appearance must never rewrite Species/Form biology, morphology, current Form, transformations, eligibility or compatibility.
Unknown/source-unspecified anatomy remains unknown and is never replaced by a human/humanoid default.
Renderer topology profiles are implementation compatibility classes, not Species, lineage or biological taxonomy.
Renderer coverage does not determine Character validity.
Equipment preview never grants, consumes, transfers, equips, unequips or mutates Asset/Inventory state.
Permission filtering occurs before hidden morphology/equipment is used for derivatives, renderer selection, counts, exports, diagnostics or AI context.
Hidden Form/marker/equipment state cannot leak through silhouette, layer count, missing-asset warnings, palette zones, anchors or renderer diagnostics.
Randomization never mutates source-owned morphology, hidden state or equipment ownership and always respects locks.
Color is not the only semantic channel; keyboard, touch, screen-reader, high-zoom, reduced-motion and nonvisual behavior are first-class.
pixel-art-v1 is the first renderer, not the permanent Character appearance data model.
No application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester, paid-service or production-credential activation is authorized.
